reason: This plugin’s primary purpose is to let an agent retrieve and parse Zhihu content, including answers, columns, and search results. Repository and package metadata identify it as a DeepSeek Harness Zhihu plugin, and the README explicitly advertises three agent tools for fetching and searching Zhihu data, which makes search/browsing integration the clearest user-facing category.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为 agent 提供知乎内容抓取与解析能力，包括回答、专栏与搜索结果读取。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides agent tools to fetch and parse Zhihu content, including answers, columns, and search results.

capabilities: Fetches and parses content from a third-party web service (Zhihu).
Provides network-based agent tools for retrieving answers/columns/search results.
May depend on browser-based authentication/session routing for stable access.

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides zhihu_fetch_column, zhihu_fetch_answer, and zhihu_search tools for agent use.
README notes Zhihu requests can be blocked (403) and suggests routing to a logged-in local browser for stable extraction.
package.json describes the package as a DeepSeek Harness Zhihu read/fetch/parse plugin and labels it with agent-tools.
